'''Replicas''' of [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were built by a [[Kursid Sith cult|cult]] to honor the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] tradition and its members' periodic returns to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kursid]]. The replicas had been constructed before the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous']] visit as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> which took place by approximately [[124 BBY]].<ref name="Note 1" /> The starship replicas were located in the center of the planet's [[Kursid arid plateau|arid plateau]] that served as a battleground, near [[Kursid totemic figures|totemic figures]] which had also been made to honor the Sith.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith starships replicas appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by author [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
